title: Governance: Deployment Checkpoint & Audit Handoff (RBACv2 + SIEM export)
summary: Working runbook for the pre-deploy governance checkpoint and automated audit handoff for production releases. Covers RBAC v2 verification, audit log schema mapping, SIEM export configuration, evidence automation steps, exception approval workflow, and sign-off template.
body:
Purpose:
Ensure every production deployment has a short, repeatable governance checkpoint that validates role gating (RBAC v2), captures required audit evidence, and hands off exports to our SIEM/evidence store before final sign-off. This doc is intentionally lightweight and meant to be copy-pasted into release threads or attached to release JIRA tickets.

Scope:
- Applies to all production-facing releases (hosted API, Dedicated capacity changes, and Private control plane updates).
- Focused on security gating: RBAC changes, sensitive config flips, key rotations, audit log availability, and SIEM export readiness.

Quick checkpoint (copy into release ticket):
- RBAC v2 review: changes recorded, least-privilege checked, approval recorded (Y/N).
- Audit stream: ingestion healthy in last 24h (Y/N).
- Audit schema conformance: snapshots taken (Y/N).
- Evidence bundle: automated export run and uploaded (Y/N + link).
- Exception flags: any temporary exceptions requested? (Y/N) If Y, link to exception doc.
- Final approvers: SecEng + Product Security + Release Engineer signatures.

RBAC v2 verification steps:
1) Pull RBAC diff: github PR -> scripts/rbac/diff-export.sh --output rbac-diff.json.
2) Manual review: ensure no new broad roles (e.g., 'org-admin' grants). Check for wildcard resource scoping.
3) Test in staging: create a test principal with new role, exercise a minimal set of actions. Log the test session id.
4) Document mitigation: if any excessive permission spotted, add scoped deny or create a temporary approval ticket with TTL.
5) Approval: assign SecEng reviewer and record approval message into release ticket.

Audit log schema (snapshot mapping for export):
- event_id -> string (uuid)
- timestamp -> iso8601_utc
- actor.principal -> string (user/service principal)
- actor.type -> enum [user, service, system]
- action -> string (e.g., model.invoke, deployment.create, kms.decrypt)
- resource.type -> string (e.g., model, deployment, secret)
- resource.id -> string
- outcome -> enum [success, failure, throttled]
- request_id -> string
- request_meta.ip -> ipv4/ipv6 (if available)
- trace.parent -> string (optional tracing id)
- kv_delta -> json_blob (small, base64 if >1KB)

Mapping notes for SIEM ingest:
- SIEM index: redwood-prod-audit.%Y.%m.%d
- Field renames: actor.principal -> user.name, request_id -> event.ref
- Enforce timestamp parsing using iso8601 to avoid index skew
- Tag all automated exports with release_tag=<release-id> and evidence_bucket_path=<s3://...>

Evidence automation runbook (one-shot before sign-off):
1) Trigger: From release pipeline, run ./ops/export_audit_bundle.sh --since=24h --release=RELEASE_ID.
2) What it does: collects audit logs, RBAC diff, deployment manifests, and relevant KMS key-rotation records. Produces a tar.gz evidence bundle.
3) Verify checksum: sha256sum produced and compared against pipeline artifact record.
4) Upload: artifact -> s3://redwood-evidence/RELEASE_ID/ (set object lifecycle 365d unless retention extension requested).
5) SIEM push: run connector to forward bundle metadata into SIEM (index + lookup fields). Connector id: siem-connector-prod-02.
6) Attach link to release JIRA and add as comment in release Slack channel.

Commands (examples):
- ./ops/export_audit_bundle.sh --since="2026-02-19T00:00:00Z" --release="v2026.02.19"
- aws s3 cp evidence/v2026.02.19.tar.gz s3://redwood-evidence/v2026.02.19/ --acl bucket-owner-full-control
- python ops/siem_loader.py --bundle s3://redwood-evidence/v2026.02.19/v2026.02.19.tar.gz --index redwood-prod-audit

SIEM export configuration checklist:
- syslog endpoint reachable from export worker (tcp/6514).
- TLS cert validated by SecOps.
- Index template applied: redwood-prod-audit-template_v3.json
- Parsing rules loaded for nested fields (actor.*, resource.*).
- Daily rollover test passed in staging for last 3 days.

Temporary exception approval flow (when RBAC or logging gaps found):
- Create an exception ticket in JIRA with label 'sec-exception' and include: justification, duration (max 7 days by default), compensating controls, rollback plan, and owner.
- Auto-notify: slack channel #sec-exceptions + pager duty for SecEng oncall.
- Approvers: Security Manager (primary), Product Owner (secondary). For exceptions >72h require CISO approval.
- Post-approval: add expiration to calendar and create automated reminder 48 hours before expiry.

Sign-off template (paste into release ticket):
- Release ID: <string>
- Planned deploy window: <start/end UTC>
- RBAC v2 changes: reviewed by <name> (link to rbac diff) -> APPROVED/REJECTED
- Audit stream health: last 24h ingestion: OK/PROBLEM (if PROBLEM add link to evidence)
- Evidence bundle: s3://redwood-evidence/<release>/ (sha256: <hex>)
- Exceptions: none / link to exception ticket
- SecEng approver: <name> (signature)
- Product Security approver: <name> (signature)
- Release Engineer: <name> (signature)

Rollback triggers (security-related):
- Unauthenticated requests observed for sensitive endpoints within 30 minutes of deploy.
- RBAC regression causing elevation of privilege in canary 1/1000 users.
- SIEM shows >10% drop in audit ingestion rate post-deploy.

Post-release monitoring and artifact retention:
- Watch audit ingestion and index latency for 72 hours.
- Snapshot indexes at +24h and +72h to evidence bucket.
- Retention: default evidence retention 365 days; escalate if data subject to legal hold.

Notes to on-call and release engineer:
- Keep the export worker logs (ops/export_worker.log) for 14 days in the release ticket.
- If connector fails, fall back to manual S3 upload and notify SecOps.
- Remember to rotate temporary credentials used by the export job after upload.

Unresolved questions (to resolve before next major release):
- Do we need a per-tenant index separation for Dedicated customers? (affects compliance workload)
- Should the evidence bundle include a scrubbed copy of request payloads by default, or only on-demand?
- Clarify SLA for evidence delivery to customers that require Private deployments.

Next actions (owner: Asha Patel):
- [ ] Finalize RBAC diff exporter to include human-readable policy comments (due 2026-03-01).
- [ ] Add automated retention metadata to evidence bundles (due 2026-03-10).
- [ ] Validate SIEM index template change in staging and schedule a full run the week of 2026-03-15.

Appendix: quick links and small snippets
- RBAC diff command: scripts/rbac/diff-export.sh --pr 2048 > /tmp/rbac-diff.json
- SIEM template PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/430
- Export worker logs: /var/log/redwood/export_worker.log (rotate daily)
